scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && uv run --project backend ruff format .
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && uv run --project backend ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && uv run --project backend ruff check .
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
